module.name: F5 CNE Address List
module.description: Creates F5BigCneAddresslist custom resource for managing IP address lists used in firewall policies and access control rules.

required.reason: FLO provides F5BigCneAddresslist CRD and controller

required.name: cluster_name
required.description: Name of the Kubernetes cluster (used for resource identification)

required.name: list_name
required.description: Name for the address list resource

required.name: flo_ready
required.description: Dependency flag ensuring FLO is ready

required.name: addresses
required.description: List of IP addresses or CIDR ranges

key_outputs.name: list_ready
key_outputs.description: Flag indicating address list is ready

key_outputs.name: list_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the created address list

key_outputs.name: list_namespace
key_outputs.description: Namespace where address list is deployed
